external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Big Blue Swim School offers swimming lessons to children from 3.5yrs, as well as adults and rookie lifesaving. We offer small class sizes, instructors in the water and progression through the Swim England awards.

Calvin holds an SQA Level 3 Early Years Swimming qualification, an ASA Level 1 and Level 2 swimming teacher qualification as well as a RLSS UK National Pool Lifeguard qualification. In addition Calvin is also a RLSS UK Trainer Assessor.

And if teaching swimming wasn’t enough for Lucy, she is also works full time as doctor for NHS Lothian. She will be taking a back seat from the day to day running of Big Blue from August 2021 when she starts speciality training, however you will no doubt still see her at our venues occasionally covering a class or checking up on us! Lucy is Big Blue’s child protection officer and holds all relevant child protection qualifications and registration with Swim Scotland.

She has recently completed her STA teacher training qualification and will be taking the lead with the training of all Big Blue staff as well as running courses for new teachers.

Kaitlin is from Aberdeen having moved to Edinburgh to study for a degree in business marketing at Napier University. She is currently undertaking her masters degree. She holds a UKCC Level 2 and is an experienced teacher with years of teaching behind her now. She also holds a RLSS National Rescue Award for Teachers and Coaches. She enjoys teaching the improver and advanced classes.

Max swam for a local swim club before becoming part of Big Blue. He has a UKCC Level 1 swim teaching certificate and is currently working towards level 2. He is a firm favourite among our youngest swimmer and teaches a number of preschool classes throughout the week. He is currently studying for an engineering degree with the open university.

Katie holds a UKCC Level 1 and 2 and joins us from Wales. She enjoys working with our younger swimmers especially the preschoolers and has been a fantastic addition to the team. Her new found love is teaching our adult swimmers on a Tuesday night. She has recently completed a language degree at Edinburgh University and will start a post-graduate law degree in September 2023, allowing us to keep her swim teaching skills in Edinburgh for another 4 years!
Robyn is one of our UKCC Level 1 instructors. She will be working at Queensferry High and Royal High School over the weekends. She is currently studying medicine at Edinburgh University.
